note: The covered market, the green iron-and-glass hall with a basket-weave glass roof in the centre of the Place du Marché. Everything is on the ground floor, one stall after another: fruit -> exotic fruit -> vegetables (zoom: the crate) -> meat and fish -> seafood and deli -> bakery -> pastry shop -> grocery (zoom: the shelf crate) -> pantry.
